This '''mobile indoctrination center''' was used by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]].

==Description==
The vessel was similar to other Rakatan designs, with a superstructure where the top "prong" was shorter than the other two and all three had a smaller "prong"-like structure next to the main ones.

==History==
The vessel was seen in a vision of the past, where it appeared to serve as the indoctrination center for [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] and other [[Force Hound]]s. Lines of tubes were stacked inside the craft, where Xesh was seen inside of one with wires and sensors covering his head.
